subject: Invoice & billing ops qualification for Acme - PO vs Card
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Daniel Park <daniel.park@acme.com>, Sofia Ramos <sofia.ramos@acme.com>
Date: 2026-11-30T09:15:00-08:00
Subject: Post-call: Procurement & billing requirements (Acme)

Hi Daniel & Sofia,

Thanks again for taking the call this morning \u001f good to meet you both. Quick recap and a few follow-ups so we can get you a quote that will sail through procurement: 

- Commercial path: you mentioned procurement prefers Purchase Order (PO) vs company card. Can you confirm that a PO is the preferred route for this engagement?
- Net terms: does Acme require net 30, net 45, or something else?
- Invoice format: any required fields (PO number placement, GL code, VAT / tax id, line item granularity)? PDF only or do you need XML/e-invoice?
- Billing contact & address: who should we send invoices to, and is there a separate remit-to address for wires?
- Marketplace interest: would you prefer buying via AWS Marketplace (if available) or a direct contract/invoice?

For reference I attached a sample Redwood invoice format so you can see our usual fields. If you have an internal procurement checklist or a PDF with invoice requirements you can forward that and we\u2019ll mirror it.

Next steps: if you confirm PO + net terms, I\u2019ll loop in our billing ops to share vendor onboarding and send a formal quote/DocuSign.

Thanks,

--
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0142
redwood.com

Attachment: redwood_invoice_sample.pdf
From: Daniel Park <daniel.park@acme.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Sofia Ramos <sofia.ramos@acme.com>
Date: 2026-11-30T10:04:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Post-call: Procurement & billing requirements (Acme)

Hi Marissa,

Thanks for the summary \u001f that helps. Confirming details from our side: 

- Commercial path: Procurement will use a PO for this engagement (we do not want to use a company card for enterprise purchases).
- Net terms: standard Net 30 for partners of this size.
- Invoice format: PDF preferred. Must include: Company legal name (Acme Corporation), billing address, VAT/Tax ID (we\u2019re US-headquartered but have EU entities; for this purchase provide both Tax ID and VAT if applicable), PO number at top, GL code in the notes line (we\u2019ll provide GL once PO is generated). Line items: product SKU, description, qty, unit price, total.
- Billing contact & remit: invoices should be emailed to finance@acme.com; remit-to address is: Acme Corporation, Attn: Accounts Payable, 120 Market St, San Francisco, CA 94105. For wires: include bank routing details on invoice or a separate remittance form.
- Marketplace: we sometimes purchase via AWS Marketplace for convenience, but for this contract we prefer a direct invoice so discounts/term negotiations flow through sales.

I attached our internal invoice requirements PDF for your billing team. Procurement timeline: expect 10\u201314 business days from receipt of vendor paperwork/quote to issue PO.

Sofia \u2014 I copied you in case there are additional finance onboarding steps.

Best,
Daniel
Daniel Park
Procurement Manager | Acme Corporation
daniel.park@acme.com | +1 (628) 555-0110

Attachment: ACME_invoice_requirements.pdf
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Daniel Park <daniel.park@acme.com>, Sofia Ramos <sofia.ramos@acme.com>
Cc: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-30T11:02:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Post-call: Procurement & billing requirements (Acme)

Great \u2014 thanks for the clear answers, Daniel. 

Short answers / next steps from our side:
- We can accept a PO and Net 30.
- I\u2019ll ask billing ops to confirm we can include the GL code on the invoice and ensure VAT fields are present for EU purchases.
- We\u2019ll send invoices as PDF to finance@acme.com and include the PO number at the top.

Looping in Sean from our billing/ops team to kick off vendor onboarding and share the DocuSign quote. Sean \u2014 can you confirm whether we need a W-9 and provide the vendor onboarding form and the format we will use for the invoice (sample attached earlier)? If possible please include a DocuSign link to the quote so Daniel can route it to procurement.

Thanks \u2014 aiming to get paperwork out today so procurement can start the PO process.

Cheers,

Marissa
--
Marissa Cole | Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0142
From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
To: Daniel Park <daniel.park@acme.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Sofia Ramos <sofia.ramos@acme.com>
Date: 2026-11-30T12:20:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Post-call: Procurement & billing requirements (Acme)

Hi Daniel / Marissa,

Thanks for the loop. Sean here (Billing Ops). Quick notes and links: 

- We can accept PO with Net 30.
- Required vendor docs: W-9 (for US entities) or W-8/W-9 as appropriate, plus our vendor onboarding form (attached).
- Invoice format requirements: PDF, include invoice number & date, PO number, vendor remit-to, line item detail (SKU + description + qty + unit price), subtotal + tax + total. If you need invoices split monthly that\u2019s possible \u2014 please specify in PO.
- Remit details: we\u2019ll include wire and ACH instructions on the invoice footer and also send a separate remittance PDF if needed.
- Marketplace: we can support AWS Marketplace if you prefer, but direct purchase will let us apply negotiated discounts/commitments.

DocuSign quote: https://www.docusign.net/Member/PowerFormSigning.aspx?env=na1&acct=11111111&powerFormId=abcd-1234
HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/12345/67890

I attached our vendor onboarding form for completion. If you can return the completed form + W-9, we\u2019ll expedite PO acceptance and issue the first invoice once the PO is received.

Thanks,
Sean Gallagher
Billing Operations | Redwood Inference
sean.gallagher@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0199

Attachment: vendor_onboarding_form.pdf

Subject: Re: Post-call: Procurement & billing requirements (Acme)

Company legal name: Acme Corporation
Billing address: Acme Corporation, Attn: Accounts Payable, 120 Market St, San Francisco, CA 94105
PO contact / finance inbox: finance@acme.com
VAT/Tax ID: 94-1234567 (US EIN) \u2014 if you need VAT for an EU entity we will provide separately.
Payment terms: PO, Net 30
Invoice split: we prefer a single monthly invoice (please include service period on invoice lines).

We\u2019ll prepare and send PO-ACME-12345 within the next 7\u201310 business days after receiving your completed vendor onboarding + quote.

Attaching a placeholder PO for our internal reference \u2014 we\u2019ll send the official signed PO once procurement completes.

Appreciate the fast turnaround.

Best,
Daniel
